task.title: topic4 dev loop: exit-line-collect (collect-artifacts.mjs reads no exit status from real tool results)
task.description: Second dev-loop task of the evaluation (evaluation/tasks/exit-line-collect). Its own task entity so that sessions and outcomes of this task are not recorded under the first task (task-5e6xp4mrrw): the gate counts distinct tasks by this id.

why: the proxy forces one task id per session (debugForceIdentity.task_id); every dev-loop run so far carried the first task's id, so the gate's distinct_tasks could never exceed 1 across the two tasks
